protocol.checkpoint_scope: One actual query-boundary disk restore per episode after query 2. The same process retains law and transition caches. No pending action. Not cold-process, production owner or mid-action recovery qualification.
protocol.cost_contract: Every candidate executes every world. Include model restoration, temporary expansion, all planner branches, checkpoint serialization/fsync/read/restore at the same query boundary, and invalid attempts. Separately report world generation, original full-search training and complete child CPU including interpreter/import/output. Numeric CPU is not joules.
protocol.failure_rule: Any candidate with an invalid episode has null utility/reward summaries in both domains; report every attempt, exception and full failure CPU. No epsilon likelihood repair or success-only estimate. Any D/HMM trace mismatch blocks all gain interpretation.
protocol.models: Original HX, free-rate, same-matrix HMM and validation-selected ordinary. Full A/B/C/D and same-Q HMM retained; all receive identical initial public events and event tapes, action interfaces, observation opportunities, fees and deadlines; purchased histories depend on each arm's own actions.

new_candidates.anchored: Eight masses and one anchor time per address, plus a common clock. Advance only moves clock. Materialize from last real observation/write; project only on actual information or write. Planner projects at the same events. Primary new compression candidate.
new_candidates.block: Eight active/recovery by content masses with uniform within-group phase reconstruction; project after each advance. Secondary, expected to depend on time partition.

protocol.new_source_rule: Freeze and publish source, protocol, inherited model hashes and selections before generation of namespace16062 worlds. Development may use only namespace16061. Keep all development and failed output.

quality_statistics.cost_gate: After compression noninferiority: both online CPU anchored/D and the complete measured new confirmation search plus inherited all-search training + candidate preparation + 1000 repeated uses anchored/D <=0.90 in both domains. Common search investment includes all candidate and failed attempts, and complete worker CPU; it is charged equally to each alternative deployment. Developer/audit CPU is separately reported and is not called whole-project cost.
quality_statistics.original_core: D-B, both domains mean >=0.01, Student t95 lower >0, two-sided exact paired sign-flip Holm across domains <0.05; unchanged from R15
quality_statistics.primary_compression: anchored-D, utility and correctness in both domains: four one-sided 98.75% Student t lower bounds strictly >-0.01
quality_statistics.reuse_investment_formula: For each fit, I = original complete training worker CPU + the sum of complete confirmation worker CPU in both domains, including all ten candidate arms and failures. Alternative deployment cost for N uses is I + its model restoration CPU + N times its measured online per-episode CPU. No candidate search cost is silently free.
quality_statistics.secondary: Block/factorized/mean comparisons descriptive only; no substitution for the primary anchored candidate after confirmation.
quality_statistics.uncertainty: CPU ratios descriptive single-run aggregates with cyclic arm order; no energy or hardware generalization. Report per-fit CPU, wall, throughput and full worker costs.
quality_statistics.unit: paired fitted model, n=8; new worlds do not create new independent fitted models

protocol.scope: Fresh-trajectory extension using eight frozen R15 fits. Finite synthetic CTMC, supplied addresses, six queries and current-query three-slot control; no retraining, learned semantics, continuum optimality, or production activation.
protocol.storage_accounting: Count persistent numeric belief and time arrays. Separately retain forty-dimensional temporaries, model matrices, caches, Python objects, disk checkpoints and process RSS; do not call the 296-byte statistic total memory.
protocol.training_source: addressed_decision_r15_20261101/run_01/training/*.json.gz; exact SHA256 identities from run_02/FREEZE.json; choices remain unchanged
